backend/main.mo: Actor importing and including a storage mixin for blob handling.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a cache-busting headshot version update and affected frontend file.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend source paths to short descriptions of each component's purpose.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with light/dark OKLCH color variables and global base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering the PortfolioPage.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Certif: Renders certifications and training items from resumeContent with cards and badges.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Contac: Displays contact methods as interactive cards with optional external links.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Educat: Shows education entries with degree, institution, dates, location, and optional details.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Experi: Displays professional experience cards with company info and responsibility bullets.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Footer: Footer showing copyright, attribution, and optional social icons.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Headsh: Modal lightbox for viewing the headshot with close controls and ESC handling.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/HeroSe: Displays the hero section with headshot, badges, summary text, and buttons including smooth-scroll and lightbox support.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Highli: Renders a grid of highlight cards showing key metrics and attributes using icons and styled cards.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Langua: Shows a multilingual skills section listing languages and proficiency levels from resume content.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Projec: Displays technical projects with descriptions, bullet points, tech badges, and optional GitHub/external links.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/RcmPor: Renders RCM case studies with tools, responsibilities, and impact lists using structured cards.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Resume: Provides a resume download button that checks asset availability and triggers a blob-based file download.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Sectio: A layout wrapper providing consistent section spacing, titles, and container structure.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Skills: Displays categorized skills from resume content using cards and badges plus a learner note.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/TopNav: Implements a responsive top navigation bar with smooth-scroll links and a mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts: Defines versioned headshot asset paths for cache-busting.
frontend/src/content/rcmPortfolioContent: Provides structured RCM case study data including roles, tools, responsibilities, and impacts.
frontend/src/content/resumeContent.ts: Defines resume data structures and a full resume object with experience, projects, skills, and contact info.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching when identity changes.
Checks whether a given asset path is available by performing HEAD/GET requests.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing as no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles, theme variables, and dialog animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, QueryClient, and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/PortfolioPage.tsx: Composes the full portfolio page layout using multiple content sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and using typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing headshot replacement tasks, image update requirements, and pending feature requests.
